title: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure not accepted by the network

entities.name: UE requested PDN connectivity procedure not accepted
entities.description: Procedure initiated when the network rejects a UE's PDN connectivity request.

entities.name: PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT
entities.description: Network-to-UE message indicating rejection of PDN connectivity request.

entities.name: Cause
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for rejection.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: UE state when registered with the network.

relations.description: Procedure involves sending PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message.
PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message contains Cause IE.
Procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
